To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Lax representation is a very useful tool for the investigation of nonlinear partial differential equations.
the general second-order partial differential equation can be represented in a Lax operator form.

the Lax representation can be used as a tool for the construction of the nonlinear evolution equations and that the Lax operator can be used as the basis for the classification of the nonlinear evolution equation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following problems: (a) to find the general form of the Lax representation of a given nonlinear partial differential equation, and (b) to find the Lax representations of a given nonlinear equation with the spectral parameter.
the problem of the classification of the nonlinear evolution equations of the second order, i.e. the problem of the determination of the matricesΩi.

the following problems: 1. to construct a general method of the representation of the nonlinear partial differential equations in the Lax form; 2. to find the conditions of the existence of the Lax representation; 3. to construct a method of the introduction of a spectral parameter in the Lax representation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Lax operator method for the nonlinear evolution equation is the generalization of the classical theory of the linear partial differential equations.
the Lax representation is the most convenient and powerful tool in the study of nonlinear evolution equations.
the Lax representation is a powerful and universal method of the description and investigation of nonlinear evolution equations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that a general second order partial differential equation with two independent variables is equivalent to a system of three ordinary differential equations of the first order.
the Lax operator method is not a new method of the theory of differential equations.
a nonlinear evolution equation of the KdV type can be represented in a Lax operator form.

a general nonlinear partial differential equation with two independent variables of any order, including the first one, can be written as a compatibility condition [X1X1+λX2]∂X/∂x2+[X2X1−λX2]−∂X/ ∂x1=0, where X is a matrix function of x1,x2 and λ.
the Lax representation is not a unique property of integrable nonlinear evolution equations.
the Lax representation is not a special feature of the integrable nonlinear equations.
